spec.title: theia PROP-001: The `theia` project type - overview and module map

status.comment: the module of the theia project type, written 2026-09-09 from the facts of upstream Theia master 1.75.0 (research/theia-facts-1.75.0); every answer below cites those facts; phase P5 of DESIGN-001

p.THEIA-TYPE-IS-AN-ANSWER-SET: `theia` is the project type (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-016#TYPE-TERM`) that carries the tool's knowledge of the Eclipse Theia monorepo as an upstream: an npm workspace of packages on Node 24, built by lerna and tsc project references and bundled by esbuild, composed at build time from one application `package.json` by inversify container modules. It is the second real type and the proof of the contract: it answers the nine questions with different shapes than the `vscode` type, and some of its answers are absences.

p.THEIA-TYPE-FROM-FACTS: Every fact of this module is derived from `research/theia-facts-1.75.0/` (upstream master `c8926e4d`, 2026-09-08, version 1.75.0) and cites its file; a fact the spike did not establish is marked as an open question, not guessed (`research/theia-facts-1.75.0/open-questions.md`).

p.THEIA-MODULE-MAP: PROP-001 the type and this map; PROP-002 upstream identity and tree layout; PROP-003 layers - the application manifest overlay, the own package, service overrides by `rebind`, no entry-module graft; PROP-004 build, watch, lint, test and packaging; PROP-005 upgrade advisory, hygiene and conventions; PROP-006 the absences - no brand images, no runtime library, no build-time stamps, no upstream packaging - and what a product supplies instead.

p.THEIA-CAPABILITIES: Declared: `config-overlay` (targets: the application `package.json`; no `dev-channel`), `service-override` (inversify `rebind` in an own container module), `build-channels` (`tsc -b -w` and `theia build --watch`), `upgrade-advisory`. Not declared in the first version: `own-extensions` (a Theia extension is own code itself - see PROP-003; VS Code-style plugins are a later capability `own-plugins`), `entry-module` (Theia needs no graft to include own code), `brand-images`, `gen-brand`, `runtime-library`. A verb that needs an undeclared capability refuses with `CK-E-TYPE-CAPABILITY` (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-016#TYPE-CAPABILITY-REFUSAL`).
